author: Kevin B. Liu
description: The first-game tutorial's in-engine loops: Scene Studio scenes filmed with the deterministic film renderer (4 samples, 180 degree shutter, 30 fps), VP9 WebM without audio, and WebP posters. Loaded only by the tutorial's card.

items.shows: A hull turned 30 degrees from an unseen shooter on Verdant Fields: three AP shots glance off its front plate in spark fans (the Angle your armour tip).
